name: websculpt
description: ブラウザで動く WebGPU 製 3D スカルプトツール（ZBrush ライク）。websculpt.html を開くだけで動作（Node 不要）

scripts.build:wasm: cd rust && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/dynafield.wasm ../wasm/dynafield.wasm
scripts.test:features: node test/features.mjs && node test/alpha-stroke.mjs && node test/morph-brush.mjs
scripts.test:modules: node test/deform.test.mjs && node test/masktools.test.mjs && node test/layers.test.mjs && node test/polygroups.test.mjs && node test/transpose.test.mjs && node test/clip.test.mjs && node test/alpha.test.mjs && node test/morph.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:modules && npm run test:gpu && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:features
